errors.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

dashboard.finishSessionBody: Your ongoing sessions will be marked as completed and filed in your history. You'll be able to start new ones for these muscle groups.

week.title: Start your week
week.desc: Tap here to start your training week. Once active, you'll be able to add sessions.

muscleGroups.title: Muscle groups
muscleGroups.desc: Tap a muscle group to create a session and add exercises. An orange badge appears while a session is in progress.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.desc: Here you'll find your latest sessions with the exercises and sets you did.

home.title: Home
home.desc: This is your main dashboard. You'll see your week, your muscle groups, and your recent activity here.

stats.title: Stats
stats.desc: Check your personal records, your progression, and your training volume by muscle group.

records.title: Personal records
records.desc: Tap the trophy to choose which exercises to track as a personal record. Once you've done the exercise at least once, your best weight will show up in Stats.

history.title: History
history.desc: Find all your past sessions organized by week. Tap a session to review the details.

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Manage your account, change your password, track your body weight, and check your progress photos.

abandoned.title: {{group}} session in progress
abandoned.body: You have a {{group}} workout in progress from {{date}}. Resume or finish it?

weightPrompt.title: What's your weight?
weightPrompt.subtitle: Enter your weight to track your progress

welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}!
welcome.subtitle: Your space to track your workouts, your progress, and reach your goals.

onboardingWeight.title: What's your current weight?
onboardingWeight.subtitle: We'll use this to track your progress

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitleLocked: Finish your first week to unlock your stats
stats.weightWillBeSaved: Your weight will be recorded every week
stats.oneRepMaxEmpty: Enable the trophy on an exercise and log a set to see its estimated 1RM here.

records.title: Personal records
records.desc: The best weight you've ever lifted for each exercise you track (enable the trophy on an exercise card to add it here).

oneRepMax.title: Estimated 1-rep max strength
oneRepMax.desc: Your estimated 1RM (Epley formula) for each tracked exercise, with its progress over time.

progression.title: Progression
progression.desc: How your body weight has evolved week by week.

volume.title: Volume by muscle group
volume.desc: The number of sets done per muscle group, to see where your training volume goes.

history.title: History
history.freePlanBanner: Free plan: last {{days}} days only — Go Pro for full history
history.noHistoryDesc: Your sessions will show up here once you start training
history.checkCalendarHint: Check the calendar to find your sessions from previous months
history.exportConfirmBody: A CSV file containing your session, exercise, and set history will be downloaded to your device.

month.title: This month
month.desc: Your history shows the weeks of the current month, with the number of sessions and sets done.

calendarView.title: Calendar view
calendarView.desc: To find a previous month, switch to the calendar view and navigate with the arrows.

sessionDetail.title: Session detail
sessionDetail.desc: Tap a session to review your exercises, weights, and reps in read-only mode.

session.emptyDesc:
Add your first exercise to
start the session

superset.title: Link as superset
superset.body: Choose the exercises to chain with no rest with {{name}}.
superset.needMore: Add another exercise to the session to create a superset.

note.title: Personal note
note.placeholder: E.g.: wider grip, sensitive shoulder, aim for 5×5...

deleteExercise.title: Delete this exercise?
deleteExercise.body: All its sets will also be deleted.

warmupModal.title: Auto warm-up
warmupModal.subtitle: Enter your working weight, we'll generate the ramp-up.

back.title: Back
back.desc: Go back to the previous screen.

addExercise.title: Add an exercise
addExercise.desc: Search and add an exercise to your session.

reorder.title: Reorder exercises
reorder.desc: Tap here to drag and drop your exercises in the order you want.

trophy.title: Track this record
trophy.desc: Enable the trophy to track this exercise's personal record in Stats.

note.title: Personal note
note.desc: Write a note about this exercise (technique, feel, goal). It stays linked to the exercise, not just this session.

superset.title: Superset
superset.desc: Link several exercises together to chain them with no rest in between.

delete.title: Delete exercise
delete.desc: Remove this exercise from the session. All its sets will also be deleted.

barMode.title: Bar mode
barMode.desc: Enable it to enter the weight added on each side of the bar — the app calculates the total weight and the plates to load.

rest.title: Rest
rest.desc: Change the rest timer duration for this specific exercise.

warmup.title: Auto warm-up
warmup.desc: Enter your working weight: the app automatically generates a progressive ramp-up before your working set.

addSet.title: Add a set
addSet.desc: Add a new set to this exercise.

weight.title: Weight
weight.desc: Enter the weight lifted. In bar mode, it's the weight added on one side of the bar.

reps.title: Reps
reps.desc: The number of reps done for this set.

type.title: Set type
type.desc: Change the set type: normal, warm-up, drop set, or to failure.

check.title: Confirm the set
check.desc: Mark the set as complete. The rest timer starts automatically if enabled.

profile.title: Profile
profile.restTimerAutoDesc: Starts as soon as a set is marked complete
profile.barModeDesc: Enter the weight on each side of the bar
profile.deleteAccountDesc: All your data will be lost
profile.loyaltyMaxed: Maximum discount reached: -${{amount}} on every renewal!
profile.proUpsellSavings: Save more and more over time, with every renewal

progressPhotos.title: Progress photos
progressPhotos.description: Take photos regularly to visualize your physical progress over time.

account.title: Account
account.description: Manage your email, password, and a recovery email in case you lose access.

weightUnit.title: Weight unit
weightUnit.description: Choose lb or kg — the whole app (sessions, stats, history) adapts to your choice.

training.title: Training
training.description: Enable the automatic rest timer and its default duration, plus bar mode to calculate the plates to load.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Delete your account and all your data. This action cannot be undone.

cancelWarning.title: Are you sure?
cancelWarning.desc: You'll lose access to unlimited history, supersets, automatic warmup, barbell mode, progress photos, and advanced charts.
cancelWarning.descWithDiscount: You'll lose your -${{amount}} loyalty discount, as well as access to unlimited history, supersets, automatic warmup, barbell mode, progress photos, and advanced charts. A future resubscription will start back at the base price.

logoutModal.title: Sign out?
logoutModal.desc: You'll need to sign in again to access your account.

deleteModal.title: Delete account?
deleteModal.desc: This action cannot be undone. All your sessions, exercises and data will be permanently deleted.

exerciseDetail.noSessionsYet: No sessions with this exercise yet

import.errorCsvOnly: The file must be in .csv format.
import.errorFileTooLarge: The file exceeds the maximum size of 10 MB.
import.errorNoData: No data recognized in this file. Check that it's a valid CSV file.
import.errorLoadExercises: Unable to load the exercise list
import.chooseFileDesc: Export your data from your training app and import it here to restore your history.
exportSteps: Come back here and select the downloaded file
import.mappingDesc: Match each unrecognized exercise to an existing one, or create it as a custom exercise.
import.willBeAdded: These sessions will be added to your history as completed.
import.importCancelledDesc: The imported sessions have been deleted.

progressPhotos.title: Progress
progressPhotos.subtitle: Track your physical progress in photos
progressPhotos.noPhotosDesc: Take a photo to start tracking your progress
progressPhotos.proOnlyDesc: Go Pro to store unlimited progress photos.
progressPhotos.tipDesc: Same pose, same lighting: the comparison will be much clearer in a month.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
